confirmation_primary: ensemble_vector versus local_vector, published_gain, exclude_endpoints, M=5; new networks only
secondary: M=10 and all other original method/pool comparisons; 95% exploratory intervals
mechanism: three matched prior SD levels .3,.6,.9; M=5,10; common networks, standard-normal parameter draws, noise draws, task and numerical model; both components ablated one at a time
analysis: per-network averages over truth/noise/target/repeated random designs; paired bootstrap ratio of means, 10000 resamples; raw MSE primary, common-scale normalized MSE secondary; full effects, network win fraction and leave-one-out influence
failure_handling: retain all finite failed-optimization records and flags; nonfinite teacher halts; no deletion based on effects
stopping: fixed sample count; runtime failures recovered using unchanged protocols; no optional stopping on significance
registration: local prospective record, not external preregistration
